name: What is AEO and how does it benefit plastic surgery practices?
description: AEO uses AI to improve a plastic surgery practice's online visibility, leading to more patient engagement and bookings.

mainEntity.name: What is AEO and how does it benefit plastic surgery practices?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO, or AI Engine Optimization, is a digital marketing strategy that leverages artificial intelligence to enhance a plastic surgery practice's online visibility. It focuses on optimizing content and digital assets to rank prominently in AI-driven search results and voice searches. For plastic surgeons, this means increased organic traffic, higher patient engagement, and a stronger online presence, leading to more consultation bookings and practice growth. AEO helps practices appear in the new ways patients are discovering information and services.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO uses AI to improve a plastic surgery practice's online visibility, leading to more patient engagement and bookings.
